title: Feelings Detective
subtitle: Match the situation to the feeling — can you crack the case?
description: Be a Feelings Detective! Match each situation to the emoji that shows how it feels. 8 cases to solve.
learning_objectives: Name common emotions and recognise what triggers them
Connect real-life situations to facial expressions and feelings
Build vocabulary for talking about emotions
reflection_prompt: Which feeling was the hardest to match, and why do you think that was?
coaching_moment: Naming a feeling is the first step to understanding it — in yourself and in others.

pairs.left: My ice cream fell on the floor
Someone took my pencil without asking
I forgot my homework at home
My best friend moved to another city
Got a big hug from grandma
Saw a spider in the bathroom
Won a prize at the school fair
